message.content: The case concerns whether inventory can certify the dispatch packing bill for Box J. Claim A, that Box J weighed 3.2 kg with packaging, is contradicted by dispatch registry S3, which records the weight as 1.4 kg. Claim B, that Box J was sent to the second workshop, is supported by S1. Claim C, that Box J contained the full replacement hinge kit at dispatch, remains unresolved; while S2 notes a typical kit weighs 1.4 kg and mentions miscellaneous hardware on the packing table, it does not confirm the kit’s completeness in Box J. Given these findings, inventory can verify the dispatch destination and weight but cannot fully certify the packing bill’s contents without further evidence.
